agents: One AI participant per original MTurk participant; no scripted roles.
scripted_roles_justification: The paper describes no confederates, experimenters or pre-recorded responses; the character in each statement is stimulus text.
order: Participants rate independently; trials in sequence within a participant (exp1: 16 single sentences; exp2 single: 12; exp2 multiple: 3 displays of four).
visibility: A participant sees only own earlier statements and ratings; never other participants' responses.
sampling_unit: participant (n = AI participants per arm; paper: exp1 114 analysed; exp2 300/300/75/75 assigned, 715 analysed)
